name: ClinDrift locked multi-sentence synthetic technical evaluation
scientific_status: Frozen technical benchmark construction; synthetic gold labels are algorithmically specified and pending independent checking. Not external clinical validation.
predeclared_research_question: Does adding a pinned NLI model and bidirectional top-1 evidence retrieval to the unchanged deterministic baseline improve case-level detection of synthetic integrity alterations while preserving false-positive control and evidence-grounded explanations?

model.selected_from: Known 140-case development experiments; exploratory v1 pilot already inspected, so results are not independently double-blind.

evaluation.scenario_family_overlap_note: New family IDs do not by themselves prove conceptual or template independence; category-level correlation remains.
evaluation.source_units: Five shared administrative distractors plus optional target fact; shuffled by fixed seed
evaluation.target_position: Shuffled in source and transformed independently; not always index zero
evaluation.no_counterpart_cases: Supported addition/omission cases explicitly have no gold counterpart and are excluded from pair recall@k rather than counted as successes.
evaluation.pairing_strategy: RapidFuzz lexical retrieval top-1 for each and every source and transformed sentence, bidirectional, without using gold query/direction as input
evaluation.semantic_automated_finding_rule: NLI label contradiction AND temperature-scaled probability >= 0.5 on any retrieved pair; record supporting pair
evaluation.conservative_rule_fusion: Keep all baseline findings. Add separately labelled AI findings; never suppress baseline positives.
evaluation.review_only_routing: Any neutral classification or weak lexical evidence (top1 similarity < 0.35) routes to human review; not counted as automated confirmed error.
primary_metrics: NLI relation correctness on oracle pairs
secondary_metrics: critical-error recall under the heuristic label rubric
evaluation.paired_statistics: Cluster bootstrap (resample 14 scenario-family groups, 3000 iterations) descriptive 95% percentile intervals; no independent-clinical significance claim.
evaluation.analysis_lock: No threshold, model revision, dataset construction, or retrieval choice may be modified after output inspection without labelling a new experiment and preserving old result.

annotation.human_validation_needed: Qualified reviewer checks category, whether omission is clinically relevant, paraphrase equivalence, exact source pair, and unresolved disagreements before final thesis adjudication.

deliverables: full-document candidate pairs and NLI scores
